title.en: An Act Creating a Branch Office of the Register of Deeds of Pangasinan with Permanent Station in the Municipality of Tayug, Province of Pangasinan
title.orig: An Act Creating a Branch Office of the Register of Deeds of Pangasinan with Permanent Station in the Municipality of Tayug, Province of Pangasinan

text.en: There is hereby created a branch office of the Register of Deeds of Pangasinan, with permanent station in the Municipality of Tayug, which shall be under the supervision of a deputy register of deeds who shall perform the duties and functions of the Register of Deeds for the following municipalities, to wit: Asingan, Balungao, San Manuel, Santa Maria, Natividad, San Nicolas, San Quintin, Rosales, Tayug and Umingan.

The said branch office shall consist of one deputy register of deeds with a salary of four thousand four hundred four pesos per annum; one senior clerk with a salary of two thousand nine hundred fifty-two pesos per annum; one clerk II with a salary of two thousand six hundred seventy-six pesos per annum; one clerk I with a salary of two thousand four hundred twenty-four pesos per annum; one janitor-messenger with a salary of two thousand one hundred sixty pesos per annum and sundry expenses in the amount of ten thousand pesos.

To carry out the purpose of this Act, twenty-four thousand six hundred sixteen pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-seven. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for the same purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966.
